INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.

4. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.

6. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

7. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Only memorise without using the language

8. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
